project: absolute path of the directory all workers operate in
directorSessionId: id of the conversation running this playbook

workers.name: local role name - identity lives here, keyed by sessionId (sidebar titles are not controllable)
workers.role: what this worker is responsible for
workers.dispatchMode: spawn | relay - spawn = we opened it via create_chat_session; relay = task handed to an already-open conversation via send_message_to_chat_session
workers.preexisting: true when the director did not create this session; such a worker must never be stopped without the human's word
workers.observedTitle: title read back from read_chat_session, for the human to locate the session; may change on its own
workers.task: one-line summary of the assigned deliverable
workers.verifiedEvidence: recomputed figure / file check that justified status=verified, empty until verified

notes: cross-worker decisions the director made, not worker output
